span.p:
Spec
[a person]
the change, and the numbers
it has to reconcile to

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
div.span:
1. Tests
[agent: test-writer]
reads the spec and the headers;
cannot read the implementation

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;
div.span:
2. Build
[agent: builder]
implements until the tests pass;
cannot edit tests, specs or scripts

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
div.span:
3. Pipeline
[no model]
build, three test suites,
static data, tick replay

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
div.span:
4. Review
[agent: numerics-reviewer]
read-only; works the arithmetic
and ends in a verdict

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Commit and push
[a person]
reads the diff and the review

span.p:
Hosted pipeline
[GitHub Actions]
stage 3 again, on the push
